scope: Public CockpitService -> real OllamaDecider protocol adapter -> real simulator, with synthetic HTTP model replies only.

red_green.failures: Opposite directions, quantities borrowed from other action clauses, direction lost across parameter followup.

red_green.failures_scope: New unknown-expression and revision false refusals plus pre-existing actor/history/English rate gaps were reproduced before repair.
Filling a later composite step must preserve the earlier completed parameter; half-unit revision must invalidate the old quantity.

behavior: Clear direction and corresponding quantity are checked together before executor.preview.
A different action clause, explicit gimbal subject or explicit past-command statement cannot supply the only evidence for body motion.
Single explicit-motion parameter revisions replace old quantities; multiple-step clarification preserves parameters of already complete steps.
Correct proposals, unknown motion phrasing, clarification followups and separately confirmed composite steps remain on the existing model/session path.
English distance-per-second and angular-rate phrases remain speed quantities; attached half units are consumed once.

examples.input: 先向前飞10米，再向左飞5米
向前飞10米 -> 改为一米半
先向前飞10米，再朝机尾方向挪6米 -> confirm first -> 继续
先向前飞10米，再向左飞 -> 5米

review.peer_final_report: Two initial false refusals and two narrower parameter issues were incorporated into tests and repaired by root.

limits: These are engineering regression test methods, not a business accuracy denominator.
Literal evidence validation is bounded; unrecognized free-form language still depends on the model, existing gates and human confirmation.
This guard does not prove universal subject/history understanding or order every repeated same-action step.
The prior 100-input model report remains immutable and belongs to its recorded source hashes; no new live model evaluation was run.
Real platform deployment, vendor authority, device execution and absolute flight accuracy remain unverified.

effects.simulator_effects: Only explicit confirmation cases in offline tests; no real dispatch.
